annotations.title: Events on a day, with company

description: Use for ONE day in a city when the question is also whether other travellers are going (city slug, date YYYY-MM-DD): each listed event with its TripHook event page (event_page, link this first), its ticket link (url), the TripHook What's on page for that day (whats_on), and how many open public day outs are going with their links (company). When the reply has more_on_page, the TripHook page lists more events than this tool returns: always show that line with its link. For what is on over several days, or a search by artist, team or event name, use search_events instead. The reply ends with links: show them as one short line, for example "Search on TripHook · What's on". Public fields only, never a person.

city.description: City slug, the city name in lower case with hyphens, as in triphook.me/events/<slug>, e.g. "vienna" or "new-york".

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD in the city's own calendar, e.g. "2026-11-21".

language.description: Language for the TripHook links, a code such as "de", "fr" or "pt-BR". Event pages exist in en, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh and ar; any other language gets the English page. Default English.
